entries.zh: 诚敬：真心实意地尊崇敬奉；诚敬之心
entries.en: true honor; to honor with sincere, genuine reverence
entries.notes: 官话栏[残]，释义据西语词头、汉字与闽南注音三栏互证。

entries.zh: 门风：家族的门第声望与家风名誉
entries.en: family honor; the repute and standing of a household

entries.zh: 荣显：荣耀显达、显赫尊荣
entries.en: glory and prominence; honored and illustrious

entries.zh: 著名：著名、出名（有好名声）
entries.en: famous, renowned; of good repute
entries.notes: 闽南栏为超出词头的多字例句（tû Bēng hō miā līã），未逐字定读，按汉字“著名”释义。

entries.zh: 普施：普遍施与、广施（指对亡灵普施祭奠、施食）
entries.en: to bestow universally; general offerings and alms made in honoring the dead
entries.notes: 闽南栏第二音节 T99 污损难辨；据汉字“普施”与西语“敬奉亡者”语境释义。

entries.zh: 普度：普度法会，中元施食超度亡灵的祭祀
entries.en: pudu: the universal-salvation (Ghost Festival) rite of offerings for the dead

entries.zh: 鞠躬：鞠躬行礼，向尊长屈身致敬
entries.en: to bow, as a gesture of reverence to elders and superiors

entries.zh: 恭敬：恭敬，恭谨有礼地敬重
entries.en: respectful; to honor and show courtesy

entries.zh: 封赠：朝廷封赐名号官爵（多追封已故者或推恩亲族）
entries.en: imperial conferral of titles and honors, often posthumous or extended to kin
entries.notes: 西语栏 fli naje 拼写不明，释义以汉字“封赠”与注音 hóng-chèng 为准。

entries.zh: 旌表：官府建坊立匾、奉旨公开表彰（忠孝节义之人）
entries.en: public commendation by royal decree, marked by an inscribed tablet, of virtue or loyalty
entries.notes: 西语栏拼写多有讹误，可辨“奉王命……立匾表彰”之义，与“旌表”相合。

entries.zh: 奖褒：褒奖称赞、嘉奖颂扬
entries.en: to commend and praise; honor by laudation

entries.zh: 奖励：奖励勉励、奖赏以示表彰
entries.en: to reward and encourage; honorary recompense

entries.zh: 设家臣：设立家臣、家中辅弼执事之臣〔与西语栏不合，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to establish household retainers and ministers [entry doubtful: the Spanish column points to funeral honors for a deceased father]
entries.notes: 西语栏指向为亡父治丧致祭（fu. 疑为 funeral，P.e 为 padre），与汉字“设家臣”对应不明，按汉字栏释义并标注存疑。

entries.zh: 重阳节：重阳节，九月初九日（登高、祭祖敬亡之节）
entries.en: Chongyang, the Double Ninth Festival (9th day of the 9th lunar month), when the dead are honored

entries.zh: 昌：昌盛兴旺、显达荣耀
entries.en: flourishing, prosperous; honored, noble
entries.notes: 闽南栏附有含西语 noble 字样的未定读例句，按汉字“昌”并参前后条（昌盛）释义。

entries.zh: 名色：名分体面、名望身分
entries.en: repute and standing; honorable name and rank

entries.zh: 好仪：仪态美好、举止得体（因而见敬）
entries.en: honorable bearing; good deportment
entries.notes: 注音 hó hān 与汉字“好儀”读音不合（更近“好漢”），按汉字栏释义。

entries.zh: 昌盛：昌盛兴旺（家道兴隆、富贵显荣）
entries.en: flourishing and prosperous; honored, rich and noble

entries.zh: 大帽：大帽（官帽），借指戴官帽者的显贵身分
entries.en: the great hat (of office), by extension honored, rich and noble rank
entries.notes: “大帽”与西语“显贵、富有、高贵”的对应取官帽象征功名之引申，属推断。

entries.zh: 门面：门面、外表体面（房屋门面；撑场面的体面）
entries.en: facade; outward face and show of respectability
entries.notes: 西语栏拼写讹乱难辨（asnoblejacion），按汉字“门面”与注音 mūy-bîn 释义。

entries.zh: 气概：气概、慷慨豪爽的气度（显贵而慷慨）
entries.en: magnanimous spirit; honorable and generous character
